scripts.start:runtime: npm run production:check && npm run start
scripts.start:production: npm run production:check && npm run db:postgres:migrate:deploy && npm run start
scripts.db:setup:postgres: npm run db:postgres:prepare && node scripts/setup-fresh-database.mjs --postgres && prisma generate --config prisma.postgresql.config.ts
scripts.db:postgres:generate: npm run db:postgres:prepare && prisma generate --config prisma.postgresql.config.ts
scripts.db:postgres:push: npm run db:postgres:prepare && prisma db push --config prisma.postgresql.config.ts
scripts.db:postgres:migrate:deploy: npm run db:postgres:prepare && (prisma migrate resolve --rolled-back 0007_restore_historical_grade_sections --config prisma.postgresql.config.ts || true) && (prisma migrate resolve --rolled-back 0008_complete_demo_academic_history --config prisma.postgresql.config.ts || true) && (prisma migrate resolve --rolled-back 0009_insert_demo_historical_grades --config prisma.postgresql.config.ts || true) && prisma migrate deploy --config prisma.postgresql.config.ts
scripts.verify:release: npm run lint && npm run build && npm audit --omit=dev
